IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.556 OF 2006
MUNILAL & ORS.                                     Petitioners
                                VERSUS
STATE OF JAMMU AND KASHMIR & ANR.              
  Respondents
O R D E R
This petition filed under Article 32 of the Constitution
of  India  inter  alia  prayed  that  some  of  the  provisions  of
Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Act, 2005 (“the Reservation Act”
for short) and the Rules framed thereunder be declared illegal
and unconstitutional. 
The matter has been pending in this Court for the last 16
years.
Mr.  Vikramjit  Banerjee,  learned  Additional  Solicitor
General has invited our attention to the factual developments
which have taken place after 2006 including certain amendments
to the provisions of the Reservation Act.
In view of the developments which have taken place since
the filing of the writ petition, we permit the petitioners to
withdraw the instant writ petition, with further liberty to
take or initiate appropriate proceedings in a manner known to
law.
